2014_spells.gate-seal.description: You fortify the fabric of the planes within a 30-foot cube centered on a point within range. Within that area, portals close and can't be opened by any means.
2014_spells.gate-seal.effectSummary: Change a target: fortify the fabric of the planes within a 30-foot cube centered on a point within range
2014_spells.gate-seal.fullDescription: Using 1 minute, you fortify the fabric of the planes within a 30-foot cube centered on a point within range. Within that area, portals close and can't be opened by any means. The effect lasts for 24 hours.
